I replied to Pree in her #central-team thread. I've logged the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. as unconfirmed, and I couldn't check it against anything I can see.

- **No record to check against:** the shared files have no Brackenwater contract or renewal record.
- **Who can confirm:** the latest notes list Brackenwater as a North team account that Marcus Lindqvist took over in September 2025. I suggested Pree ask him or June Osei-Lark (deal desk) to check the date against the contract.

Until one of them confirms it, I'm treating 8 April as hearsay.
